basic_info.description: New Price! Welcome to this "Corner of the Sky" perched high above SF where amazing vistas abound. Expansive windows frame SF's dramatic cityscape; a living painting that transforms throughout the day. The open floor plan is an entertainer's dream; guests can marvel at twinkling city lights while you serve from the modern kitchen. This spacious 3-bed, 2-bath haven with its private entry, captivates from the moment you enter. The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a wall mounted A/C unit, while two other bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, a kid's room, or work-from-home office. Both baths have been meticulously updated with elegant finishes. This rare gem boasts verdant green space at one end creating a sense of expansiveness and tranquility rarely found in city living. With space for a growing family or tech professionals to thrive, this home offers great versatility. The private deck extends the living space outdoors, an ideal setting for morning coffee or evening cocktails. Newly installed floors flow throughout, complementing the serene neutral palette allowing the view to take center stage. More than a home, it's a front-row seat to SF's skyline performance, a rare opportunity to claim your very own corner of the sky in the coveted city of SF.
